issues.title: Unspecified problem still not working
issues.problem_statement: The customer said a problem discussed earlier is still not working after trying a previous fix twice; the transcript never names the problem or the product area.

items.description: An unnamed problem was still occurring after the customer repeated an earlier fix twice and after a further attempt from a setting support pointed to; the problem and the setting are not named.
evidence: Yes, twice. It comes back every time.

items.description: The speakers agreed that "the other thing" would be done and that the customer would be told or would report back, and that a second unnamed matter is also pending; who does what and what the matters are cannot be determined.
evidence: So we'll do that other thing and you let me know.
Yes, that too. I'll see what can be done.

skip_recommendation.explanation: Generic speaker labels and vague references mean neither the problem, the next steps nor who owns them can be established with at least medium confidence.
